'''Marn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] who lived during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. After the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Salus Bralor]]'s son [[Jogo]] at the hands of a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]], Marn accompanied Bralor to the [[Taris Orbital Station]] in order to confront the hunter. When Bralor challenged the hunter to a [[Taung blood duel]], Marn fought as Bralor's second and was [[Death/Legends|killed]] as a result.
